#37166 removes 「Build with AI」 at the shared source (`useAddAppEntries`) and always shows the blank-app entry in the no-apps state, which is the ruled shape. That makes #37166 the owner of the desktop no-apps state. PR #37249 conflicts with it textually in `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732.test.tsx`, so it waits.

Held work, not pushed; PR #37249 stays at `230a11df2`:
- `22e09d193`: the phone zero-app admin welcome, where the build agent is deployed, shows the no-apps title and the existing NoBuild/NoAi description. `home.welcomeAdminDescription` is retired from all 11 packs. The commit adds pins and a no-agent control.
- `7ed857943`: the changeset declares the copy change and the retired key.
- Patches: the zone's scratchpad, `issue-37227/rework-patches/`. The branch commits are also kept in the worktree `objectstack-issue-37227`.

When #37166 merges, the branch rebases onto `main`. The now-redundant desktop no-apps filtering, its test edit and the ruling-1 gap note are dropped. The PR keeps:
- the greeting-row chip removal;
- 「Build with AI」 removed from `HomeAiActions`;
- the welcome copy;
- the retired keys (`home.build.title`, `home.welcomeAdminDescription`), declared under `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`.

Then it goes to the seat for a delta L1 and a same-head contract review.
